newsitem.title: USA: CSX sees early EPS dilution from Conrail.
newsitem.headline: CSX sees early EPS dilution from Conrail.

text.p: CSX Corp said Thursday the Conrail Inc deal is expected to dilute earnings per share by three percent in 1997 and two percent in 1998.
The figures reflect a revision from estimates unveiled earlier this month, when CSX said it anticipated earnings dilution of one percent in 1997 and break-even impact in 1998.
CSX officials said the revision reflects interest rate changes. They said more minor changes are likely in the future.

In a meeting with Wall Street analysts, CSX also said the Conrail deal will likely result in pricing pressure in some markets. But it said it expects it will be able to manage any pricing pressures because unit costs will be declining and volumes will be increasing.
CSX is to buy 42 percent of Conrail, and Norfolk Southern Corp is to buy the rest.
